recipes.name: workflow-patterns

recipes.task: Three workflow patterns as one short file each, on the course LLM gateway or an offline stub: a prompt chain with a code check between calls, parallel calls (sectioning and voting), and an evaluator-optimizer loop with a model or a code check as the evaluator

practices.name: Prompt chain: a fixed order of model calls, each reading the reply before it, with a code check between calls that can stop the chain
practices.source: Anthropic, Building effective agents (Workflow: Prompt chaining); AI Engineering ch. 5, Break Complex Tasks into Simpler Subtasks; L17

practices.name: Parallel calls: independent calls at the same time, combined by app code (sectioning), or the same task several times with a majority (voting)
practices.source: Anthropic, Building effective agents (Workflow: Parallelization); AI Engineering ch. 10, AI Pipeline Orchestration; L17

practices.name: Evaluator-optimizer: a draft, a pass or fail with feedback from a model call or a code check, and a loop with a round limit in app code
practices.source: Anthropic, Building effective agents (Workflow: Evaluator-optimizer); AI Engineering ch. 6, Reflection and error correction; L17

practices.name: A cap on model calls that the model cannot remove
practices.source: L17, L18 (limits outside the model)

validates.shows: The chain makes its three calls in order and each reads the reply before it; a pick with an unlisted product stops the chain after two calls; the two sectioning calls and the three votes are in flight at the same time; the majority label wins and no majority is reported as such; feedback reaches the next generator call; the loop stops at three rounds; the call over the cap is not made; the gateway client sends the OpenAI chat request shape and does not retry

recipes.cost_one_run: less than 0.004 CAD of gateway budget for the three files together: at most 12 model calls of at most 1500 output tokens each at the price of qwen3.8-27b in model-routing (an upper bound, not measured); the recipe does not create AWS resources

recipes.name: zero-etl-search
recipes.summary: DynamoDB stays the source of truth; a Lambda function on its stream keeps a keyword index in OpenSearch Serverless in step, one document per item key, with bad records set aside in a queue; a notebook shows a table change becoming searchable

practices.name: The source of truth stays in DynamoDB; the search index is derived from it and can be rebuilt
practices.source: L14; DDIA 2e ch. 12 'Databases and Streams', 'Change Data Capture'

practices.name: Idempotent writes: the item key is the document id, so a retried batch leaves one document per item
practices.source: REL04-BP04 make mutating operations idempotent

practices.name: One bad record does not block the stream: bisect on error, a bounded number of retries, an on-failure queue
practices.source: L14; AWS docs, Lambda: retain discarded records for a DynamoDB event source

practices.name: Temporary errors are retried with backoff and jitter inside the function, then from the earliest unwritten record (partial batch response); only refused records are set aside
practices.source: REL05-BP03 control and limit retry calls; AWS docs, Lambda: partial batch response with DynamoDB

practices.name: Capacity that scales to zero, with the smallest maximum the service allows
practices.source: AWS docs, OpenSearch Serverless collection group capacity limits and scale to zero; course constraint (sandbox budget)

practices.name: Least privilege: the function may write documents in one index of one collection; the data access policy and the IAM role name no wildcard resources
practices.source: SEC03-BP02 grant least privilege access; AWS docs, OpenSearch Serverless data access policies

practices.name: Index versions are recorded: in the index name, the mapping's _meta and every document
practices.source: L17; course choice

validates.shows: inserts, updates and deletes reach the stand-in index through the real handler; a replayed batch leaves the same documents; temporary errors (6 or 30 failing calls in a row) lose no good record; a refused record ends alone in the failure queue and the next write still arrives; requests are signed for aoss; the policies name no wildcard resources; clean-up leaves nothing; the extensions' definitions validate
